test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - GA (Held On 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Consider the following statements:****1. Iltutmish succeeded Qutub-ud-din Aibak and was later followed by his daughter Razia.
2. Razia ruled the Delhi Sultanate for several decades, marking one of the longest reigns of any female monarch.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct**?
solution:
The correct answer is __**only 1**__.

**__Key Points__**

• **Shams-ud-din Iltutmish** (reigned **1211–1236**) was the third ruler of the **Mamluk Dynasty** (Slave Dynasty). He was a slave of **Qutub-ud-din Aibak** and later became his son-in-law. After the death of **Aibak** in **1210** and the brief, unsuccessful reign of **Aram Shah**, **Iltutmish** ascended the throne in **1211**. Before his death, he nominated his daughter, **Razia Sultan**, as his successor because he felt his sons were incapable of ruling. Although **Rukn-ud-din Firuz** (his son) sat on the throne for a few months after **Iltutmish** died in **1236**, he was deposed, and **Razia Sultan** became the **Sultan** in the same year. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
